healing_potion.name: Healing Potion
healing_potion.description: Restore 5 health plus Potion Healing bonuses.

greater_healing_potion.name: Greater Healing Potion
greater_healing_potion.description: Restore 9 health plus Potion Healing bonuses.

focus_tonic.name: Focus Tonic
focus_tonic.description: Restore 2 points of your class resource.

smoke_vial.name: Smoke Vial
smoke_vial.description: Become Hidden until you attack or an adjacent enemy reveals you.

warding_draught.name: Warding Draught
warding_draught.description: Gain 3 temporary Aegis against the next damaging hit.

fleet_draught.name: Fleet Draught
fleet_draught.description: Gain 2 ordinary movement this turn without spending another action.

haste_potion.name: Potion of Haste
haste_potion.description: Double your remaining movement and gain one additional action this turn.

fury_potion.name: Potion of Fury
fury_potion.description: Your next attack deals double damage.

resource_elixir.name: Resource Elixir
resource_elixir.description: Completely fill your class resource meter.

true_strike_tonic.name: True-Strike Tonic
true_strike_tonic.description: Gain +8 Accuracy on your next attack.

firebreak_draught.name: Firebreak Draught
firebreak_draught.description: Gain 3 temporary Aegis against the next hit, brewed for the Farmstead's spreading fires.
